points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable source clean-builds under isolated network-disabled 2 CPUs/3GiB/256 processes; no CTests registered.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Input-driven case/output, flux and transient control overrides; no full case rerun.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separate case, mesh, partition, flux, solver and output modules; fixed 2-D state remains.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal executable wrapper identified; external similarity investigation excluded under trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case-configured CGNS and BC instead of fixed filenames; CGNS MIXED sections unsupported.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: Root-only global mesh and METIS with owned/ghost halos; exact historic rank-study binaries unbound.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positivity and finite checks present; no independent memory stress test.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Eight original attempt outputs passed recorded validator, isolated build succeeded; no registered CTests or unsteady rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Modular source/report tooling; actual final response attribution corrected and original artifacts preserved in Git.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
